name: Pat Donan
bio: Pat Donan was a Dakota booster whose glowing claims the Cow Boy rejected in 1884, and when he was mentioned for governor that June the paper denounced the idea. In January 1886 it named "Col. Pat. Donan" as part of a syndicate advertising a venture and warned the account would be flowery.
